phase: CarePoint Phase 4 - Controlled Pilot / Go-Live Execution
purpose: Define controlled pilot launch execution for day-0 and day-1 using QA-V7 closure evidence and PILOT-V2 staging rehearsal evidence.

entryPosition.executionMode: controlled pilot launch; no runtime code change in this package

launchGates.name: Release candidate frozen
launchGates.passCriteria: One approved release candidate is identified for the pilot launch window.

launchGates.name: QA/UAT closure evidence accepted
launchGates.passCriteria: QA phase is closed and any remaining items are explicitly accepted or deferred.

launchGates.name: Staging rehearsal passed or approved with waiver
launchGates.passCriteria: PILOT-V2 has a continue outcome or signed exception with owner/date.

launchGates.name: Pilot cohort confirmed
launchGates.passCriteria: Pilot users, roles, support window and communication channel are confirmed.

launchGates.name: Support command center active
launchGates.passCriteria: Support owner and escalation path are active before day-0 launch.

launchGates.name: Rollback and pause authority confirmed
launchGates.passCriteria: A named owner can pause, rollback or continue during day-0/day-1.

launchGates.name: Day-0 smoke path ready
launchGates.passCriteria: Critical smoke path is defined and assigned.

launchGates.name: Day-1 monitoring window scheduled
launchGates.passCriteria: Monitoring, support and evidence review window exists for first operational day.

day0Runbook.action: Confirm selected release package, checksum and staging target.
day0Runbook.expectedEvidence: Release candidate record and checksum captured.

day0Runbook.action: Confirm environment variables, secrets, backup, migration and rollback status.
Run launch gate audit and confirm QA-V7/PILOT-V2 evidence is present.
day0Runbook.expectedEvidence: npm run audit:qa and npm run audit:pilot outputs captured.

day0Runbook.action: Activate the pilot release in the controlled target environment.
Execute Admin smoke: login, protected route, account/configuration surface, audit visibility.
Execute Provider smoke: login, dashboard, queue, calendar, prescription or encounter-note surface.
Execute API/Python smoke: API build evidence, hybrid prepare endpoint coverage, worker verification.
Open command center and confirm support coverage with pilot cohort.
day0Runbook.expectedEvidence: Support channel and on-call owner active.

day0Runbook.action: Enable pilot cohort access and send launch communication.
day0Runbook.expectedEvidence: Cohort activation record and communication timestamp.

day0Runbook.action: Record day-0 status: continue, hold, rollback or retry launch.
day0Runbook.expectedEvidence: Day-0 decision record with blockers and owners.

day1Runbook.action: Review overnight/early support events, access issues and P0/P1 defects.
Confirm pilot cohort can use expected Admin/Provider workflows.
Triage defects with severity, owner, target date and pilot impact.
Confirm logs, API/Python behavior, performance smoke and data handling evidence.
Collect structured feedback from Admin, Provider and Operator/Reviewer representatives.
Record daily pilot decision: continue, hold, rollback, hotfix, or expand-preparation.

communicationPlan.message: Pilot scope, supported workflows, support channel, known limits and feedback process.
Severity matrix, escalation owner, response expectations and evidence capture.
Deployment state, rollback triggers, open risks and go/no-go decision updates.
Pilot health, defects, feedback, adoption evidence and next recommended action.

pauseRollbackTriggers.trigger: Authentication outage or repeated access failure for pilot cohort
Role boundary or protected route failure
Data integrity issue or suspected data loss
API/Python worker failure blocking critical workflow
Inability to capture logs/evidence for incident review
Support channel unavailable during launch window

decisionStates.meaning: Pilot remains active and moves to daily monitoring.
Pilot access or expansion pauses until blockers have owners and dates.
Pilot activation is reverted according to approved rollback path.
Launch runbook is repeated after correction of an activation or smoke issue.
A controlled correction is required before pilot can continue or expand.

evidenceOutputs.nextDeliveryInput: PILOT-V4 monitoring, support, incident triage, and daily health review

nextRecommendedDelivery: PILOT-V4 - Pilot monitoring, support, incident triage, and daily health review
